64-4875-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
64-4875-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Conspiracy, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

985-1322-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for {0} that dies on enter

1957-2530-5789--203.easyPrerequisites: You either have at least 2 life or {B} available.
1957-2530-5789--203.description:
Cast the creature card from your hand for {0}. The creature enters, then immediately dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the creature enters, Carnival of Souls and Lifecreed Duo trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls ability, adding {B} and losing 1 life.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo ability, gaining at least 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1734-2150-8095.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Mana Dork that Adds At Least {1}{G}

215-579--85--181.easyPrerequisites: The mana dork chosen from the template must add at least {1}{G}.
215-579--85--181.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding twice the usual amount of mana due to Mana Reflection.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning the mana-producing creature from the battlefield to your hand and giving Temur Sabertooth indestructible until end of turn.
Cast the mana-producing creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat any number of times.
If the loop produces infinite mana (see Notes), you can then spend that mana to activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times, returning and recasting any creatures you control whose costs can be paid for by the type of mana you have.
215-579--85--181.notes: In order for this combo to work, a mana dork that costs one mana to play must tap to add at least two mana before modifiers. A mana dork that costs two mana can go infinite if it adds two mana, but must add at least three to produce infinite mana. A mana dork that costs three must add at least three mana.

2457-4289-6705-7730.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1394-2060-3967-7038-7741.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Shang-Chi.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Shang-Chi.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

772-3175-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

240-2034-2079-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-3000-5226-6737.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token due to Chatterfang.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat from step 2.

632-2034-3621-5129-7295.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-2034-3621-5129-7295.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

1563-2457-4772-7297.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

4038-4171-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Kozilek's Channeler's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

141-5117-6797.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Phantom Train abilities from step 5.

1978-2734-4563.description:
Animate Everflowing Chalice using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Repeat from step 2.

1387-1500-2100-2633-6596.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}. Urabrask, Blood Funnel and Hermes trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Hermes trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Searing Touch spell.
Repeat.

301-1099-4419.description:
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability.
Repeat.

4871-5695-5752-6798.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Brokkos.
When Brokkos dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot four times by sacrificing four Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot abilities
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U/B}{G}{G}.
Cast Brokkos from your graveyard for its mutate cost by paying {2}{U/B}{G}{G}, putting it on top of a Saproling.
Repeat from step 3.

413-628-6672.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrifiicing Bloodied Ghost.
When Bloodied Ghost dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. When it enters, Bloodied Ghost will put a -1/-1 counter on itself, removing the +1/+1 counter.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1698-3260-3540-6580.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures.
You have at least three opponents.
1698-3260-3540-6580.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life if able, or {B} otherwise.
Each creature you control's extort ability triggers.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay 2 life if able, or {W/B} otherwise, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining extort trigger.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat until an opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
1698-3260-3540-6580.notes: Once you have two or less opponents, the combo no longer makes enough life to continue. You may repeat the loop using your own resources as desired.

776-4113--15.description:
Cast the buyback spell with buyback by tapping any number of creatures.
Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve the spell with buyback, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

4824-5168-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Bloom Tender's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2034-2523-5559.description:
Cast Nazgûl by paying {2}{B}.
Nazgûl enters, triggering its first activated ability, causing the Ring to tempt you; choose Nazgûl as your Ring-bearer, making it legendary.
Nazgûl's second activated ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Wraith you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nazgûl, adding {2}.
Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Nazgûl that's a 2/2 Zombie.
Repeat from step 2.

1808-2438-2837.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1808-2438-2837.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first Eloise trigger, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Resolve the second Eloise trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

647-3259-5734.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.
647-3259-5734.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-643-3466-4120.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
240-643-3466-4120.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control by any method.
When that creature enters the battlefield, Reaper King triggers, destroying that creature.
Resolve Atla Palani's trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 until Vigor enters the battlefield then dies, or until you choose to end the loop by destroying an opponent's permanent.
If Vigor dies, it and Atla Palani trigger.
Resolve Vigor's trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Continue from step 3.

283-2113-5137.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers and Karametra's Favor attached to Morphling.
Morphling does not have summoning sickness.
283-2113-5137.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Morphling's first ability by paying {U}.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Morphling's ability.
Resolve the copy of Morphling's ability, untapping it.
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
 Resolve Morphling's ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

1427-2793.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other artifact.
1427-2793.description:
Cast Masterful Replication by paying {5}{U}, causing each artifact you control to become a copy of Ugin's Nexus until end of turn.
Put the original Ugin's Nexus and all other artifacts you control except one into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take that many extra turns after this one.

1992-4050-4381.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-4050-4381.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter, adding one mana of any color.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Grumgully triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Knight token.
Repeat.

2034-3545-5189.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-3545-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Sigil Captain triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on that Saproling.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Sigil Captain triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on that Saproling.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Saproling token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may activate Ghave infinite times.

3201-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Arixmethes does not have summoning sickness.
Arixmethes has no slumber counters on it.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Arixmethes.
3201-3525.description:
Activate Arixmethes, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura, untapping Arixmethes.
Repeat.
